note: Generated by _schema/build_dictionary.js from information_schema and measured column lengths. Do not hand-edit except for the description fields, which are preserved on regeneration.

fields.name: poolId
fields.description: Alias of mappedPoolId, retained for compatibility.

fields.name: poolStatus
fields.description: Alias of mappedPoolStatus, retained for compatibility.

fields.name: townName
fields.description: Town containing the pool.

fields.name: countyName
fields.description: County containing the pool. Stored uppercase.

fields.name: vpatlas_pool_url
fields.description: Deep link to the pool on vpatlas.org.

fields.name: vpatlas_visit_url
fields.description: Deep link to the visit on vpatlas.org.

fields.name: visitId
fields.description: Unique identifier for this visit record.

fields.name: visitPoolId
fields.description: Identifier of the pool visited; joins to mappedPoolId.

fields.name: visitDate
fields.description: Date the pool was visited.
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: visitLocatePool
fields.description: Whether the observer located the pool in the field. 1 = yes, 0 = no; null means not recorded.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitCertainty
fields.description: Observer's certainty that the feature found was the mapped pool: Certain, Pretty Sure or Not Sure.

fields.name: visitNavMethod
fields.description: How the observer navigated to the pool: GPS, Map, Map and compass, prior knowledge of the site, or other.

fields.name: visitCoordSource
fields.description: Source of the coordinates used to find the pool, often the name of an originating shapefile or GPS.

fields.name: visitLatitude
fields.description: Latitude recorded at the pool during the visit, WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: visitLongitude
fields.description: Longitude recorded at the pool during the visit, WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: visitVernalPool
fields.description: Observer's determination of whether the feature is a vernal pool: Yes, No or Don't Know.

fields.name: visitPoolType
fields.description: Landform setting of the pool, such as Isolated Forest Depression, Floodplain Depression, or Manmade.
domain: Pool associated with larger wetland complex

fields.name: visitInletType
fields.description: Nature of any inflow to the pool: No Inlet, Ephemeral Inlet or Permanent Inlet.

fields.name: visitOutletType
fields.description: Nature of any outflow from the pool: No Outlet, Ephemeral Outlet or Permanent Outlet.

fields.name: visitForestUpland
fields.description: Dominant forest type of the surrounding upland. Hardwood and Deciduous are equivalent, as are Softwood and Coniferous; both spellings persist in the data and each activates the same form control.

fields.name: visitForestCondition
fields.description: Condition of the surrounding forest. Minor logging and Major logging are both represented by the form's single Recently Logged option; the stored distinction is preserved on edit.

fields.name: visitHabitatAgriculture
fields.description: Agricultural land present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatLightDev
fields.description: Light development present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatHeavyDev
fields.description: Heavy development present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatPavedRd
fields.description: Paved road present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatDirtRd
fields.description: Dirt road present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatPowerline
fields.description: Powerline corridor present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitHabitatOther
fields.description: Other surrounding habitat feature not covered by the habitat flags.

fields.name: visitHabitatComment
fields.description: Observer's notes on the surrounding habitat. Truncated to 254 characters in the shapefile export.

fields.name: visitMaxDepth
fields.description: Maximum water depth observed. Free text; values range from measurements to descriptive depths such as 'Knee-deep'.

fields.name: visitWaterLevelObs
fields.description: Water level at the time of the visit: Full, More than 50%, Less than 50%, or Dry.

fields.name: visitHydroPeriod
fields.description: How long the pool holds water: Ephemeral, Dries annually, Dries every 5 years, Semi-permanent, Never dries or Permanent.

fields.name: visitMaxWidth
fields.description: Maximum width of the pool, in feet.

fields.name: visitMaxLength
fields.description: Maximum length of the pool, in feet.

fields.name: visitPoolTrees
fields.description: Percent of the pool shaded or occupied by trees, 0-100.

fields.name: visitPoolShrubs
fields.description: Percent of the pool occupied by shrubs, 0-100.

fields.name: visitPoolEmergents
fields.description: Percent of the pool occupied by emergent vegetation, 0-100.

fields.name: visitPoolFloatingVeg
fields.description: Percent of the pool occupied by floating vegetation, 0-100.

fields.name: visitSubstrate
fields.description: Dominant pool substrate: Leaf litter, Mud, Sand/Gravel, Bedrock or Other.

fields.name: visitDisturbDumping
fields.description: Evidence of dumping at the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitDisturbSiltation
fields.description: Evidence of siltation at the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitDisturbVehicleRuts
fields.description: Evidence of vehicle ruts at the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitDisturbRunoff
fields.description: Evidence of runoff affecting the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitDisturbDitching
fields.description: Evidence of ditching at or near the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitDisturbOther
fields.description: Other disturbance observed, not covered by the disturbance flags.

fields.name: visitWoodFrogAdults
fields.description: Count of adult wood frogs (Lithobates sylvaticus) observed.

fields.name: visitWoodFrogLarvae
fields.description: Count of wood frog larvae observed.

fields.name: visitWoodFrogEgg
fields.description: Count of wood frog egg masses observed. A primary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitWoodFrogEggHow
fields.description: Whether the wood frog egg mass count was Counted or Estimated.

fields.name: visitSpsAdults
fields.description: Count of adult spotted salamanders (Ambystoma maculatum) observed.

fields.name: visitSpsLarvae
fields.description: Count of spotted salamander larvae observed.

fields.name: visitSpsEgg
fields.description: Count of spotted salamander egg masses observed. A primary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitSpsEggHow
fields.description: Whether the spotted salamander egg mass count was Counted or Estimated.

fields.name: visitJesaAdults
fields.description: Count of adult Jefferson salamanders (Ambystoma jeffersonianum) observed.

fields.name: visitJesaLarvae
fields.description: Count of Jefferson salamander larvae observed.

fields.name: visitJesaEgg
fields.description: Count of Jefferson salamander egg masses observed. A primary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitJesaEggHow
fields.description: Whether the Jefferson salamander egg mass count was Counted or Estimated.

fields.name: visitBssaAdults
fields.description: Count of adult blue-spotted salamanders (Ambystoma laterale) observed.

fields.name: visitBssaLarvae
fields.description: Count of blue-spotted salamander larvae observed.

fields.name: visitBssaEgg
fields.description: Count of blue-spotted salamander egg masses observed. A primary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitBssaEggHow
fields.description: Whether the blue-spotted salamander egg mass count was Counted or Estimated.

fields.name: visitFairyShrimp
fields.description: Count of fairy shrimp (Anostraca) observed. A primary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitFingerNailClams
fields.description: Count of fingernail clams (Sphaeriidae) observed. A secondary vernal pool indicator.

fields.name: visitSpeciesOther1
fields.description: Additional species observed at the pool.

fields.name: visitSpeciesOther2
fields.description: Further additional species observed at the pool.

fields.name: visitFish
fields.description: Fish observed in the pool. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Fish presence generally disqualifies a pool as vernal habitat.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitFishCount
fields.description: Number of fish observed. Free text; may hold a count or a descriptive abundance.

fields.name: visitFishSizeSmall
fields.description: Fish abundance recorded for the small size class. Sparsely recorded.

fields.name: visitFishSizeMedium
fields.description: Fish abundance recorded for the medium size class. Sparsely recorded.

fields.name: visitFishSizeLarge
fields.description: Fish abundance recorded for the large size class. Sparsely recorded.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp the visit record was created in VPAtlas (UTC).
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp the visit record was last modified in VPAtlas (UTC).
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: visitPoolMapped
fields.description: Whether the pool had already been mapped before this visit. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitUserIsLandowner
fields.description: Whether the observer was the landowner. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Observer identity is not published.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitLandownerPermission
fields.description: Whether landowner permission for this visit is on record. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Landowner identity is not published.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitFishSize
fields.description: Size class of fish observed: Small, Medium or Large.

fields.name: visitNavMethodOther
fields.description: Navigation method, where visitNavMethod is Other.

fields.name: visitPoolTypeOther
fields.description: Pool type, where visitPoolType is Other.

fields.name: visitSubstrateOther
fields.description: Substrate, where visitSubstrate is Other.

fields.name: visitSpeciesOtherName
fields.description: Name of the additional species recorded in visitSpeciesOtherCount.

fields.name: visitSpeciesOtherCount
fields.description: Count of the additional species named in visitSpeciesOtherName.

fields.name: visitLocationUncertainty
fields.description: Positional uncertainty of the visit coordinates as recorded by the observer.

fields.name: visitSubmergedVeg
fields.description: Percent of the pool occupied by submerged vegetation, 0-100.

fields.name: visitHabitatTrails
fields.description: Trails present in the surrounding habitat. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: visitAmphibianDisease
fields.description: Signs of amphibian disease observed. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: lastEditedAt
fields.description: Timestamp the visit record was last edited (UTC).
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: mappedPoolId
fields.description: Unique VPAtlas identifier for the pool. Identifiers prefixed NEW were assigned by the atlas; others carry the identifier from the source dataset.

fields.name: mappedDateText
fields.description: Date the pool was mapped or first entered into the atlas.
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: mappedLatitude
fields.description: Latitude of the mapped pool centre, WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: mappedLongitude
fields.description: Longitude of the mapped pool centre, WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: mappedConfidence
fields.description: Mapper's confidence that the mapped feature is a vernal pool, from L (low) through H (high). UNK where not assessed.

fields.name: mappedSource
fields.description: Dataset, project or organisation the pool record originated from.

fields.name: mappedSource2
fields.description: Secondary source, where the record was corroborated by or merged from more than one origin.

fields.name: mappedPhotoNumber
fields.description: Reference number of the photograph taken of the pool, where one exists.

fields.name: mappedLocationAccuracy
fields.description: Confidence in the positional accuracy of the mapped coordinates, from L (low) through H (high). UNK where not assessed.

fields.name: mappedMethod
fields.description: How the pool was identified: Aerial photography, CIR or LiDAR imagery, NDWI, a field Visit or Survey, or previously Known.

fields.name: mappedLandownerPermission
fields.description: Whether landowner permission to access the pool is on record. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Landowner identity is not published.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: mappedLocationUncertainty
fields.description: Positional uncertainty of the mapped coordinates as recorded by the mapper.

fields.name: mappedPoolStatus
fields.description: Verification status of the pool. Potential means mapped but unvisited; Probable and Confirmed reflect field evidence. Eliminated and Duplicate records are not published.

fields.name: reviewId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the quality-assurance review of this visit, where one exists.

fields.name: reviewPoolId
fields.description: Identifier of the pool the review applies to.

fields.name: reviewVisitId
fields.description: Identifier of the visit the review applies to.

fields.name: reviewQACode
fields.description: Quality-assurance outcome code assigned by the reviewer.

fields.name: reviewQAAlt
fields.description: Alternate quality-assurance code, where the reviewer recorded one.

fields.name: reviewQADate
fields.description: Date the quality-assurance review was completed.
fields.conversion: formatted as ISO-8601 UTC text in every published format, identically

fields.name: reviewPoolStatus
fields.description: Pool status assigned by the reviewer, which may differ from the status recorded at the visit.

fields.name: reviewPoolLocator
fields.description: Whether the reviewer could locate the pool from the visit record. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
fields.conversion: boolean emitted as smallint 0/1 (ArcGIS has no boolean field type)

fields.name: reviewReasons
fields.description: Reasons recorded by the reviewer for the assigned status, as a comma-delimited list.
fields.conversion: array flattened to a comma-delimited string
